mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right wood and finish for my custom carpentry project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right wood and finish depends on your project's intended use, desired aesthetic, and budget. Hardwoods like oak or maple offer durability for high-traffic areas, while softer woods like pine can be more cost-effective. Finishes range from natural oils that highlight grain to paints that provide a solid color. Consider factors like moisture exposure and potential wear when making your selections. Our team can guide you through the options, explaining the properties and benefits of each material.
